title: The Surprising Expressivity of a Single Neuron with Autoregressive Chain-of-Thought
abstract: arXiv:2610.17283v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The success of autoregressive language models trained with Chain-of-Thought~(CoT) supervision raises a fundamental question: How simple can a next-token predictor be while still enabling the efficient simulation of general computation through its autoregressively generated CoT? Surprisingly, we show that a single neuron suffices. For a broad family of activations, including threshold and ReLU, a single autoregressive neuron can simulate any feedforward circuit with the same activation. Specifically, a size-$s$ circuit on $n$ inputs can be simulated by a neuron of dimension $O(ns+s^2)$ using $O(s^2)$ generation steps, with both bounds independent of circuit depth and tight under natural assumptions. For threshold activations, this improves upon the simulation of Joshi et al. (COLT 2025), whose bounds scale exponentially with circuit depth. Consequently, autoregressive threshold neurons can simulate polynomial-time Turing machines, while

translated_title: 带自回归思维链的单个神经元的惊人表达能力
translated_abstract: 使用思维链监督训练的自回归语言模型的成功提出了一个根本性问题：下一个词预测器可以有多简单，同时仍能通过其自回归生成的思维链高效地模拟通用计算？令人惊讶的是，我们证明单个神经元就足够了。对于包括阈值函数和ReLU在内的广泛激活函数家族，单个自回归神经元可以模拟任何具有相同激活函数的前馈电路。具体而言，一个在 $n$ 个输入上、规模为 $s$ 的电路，可以由一个维度为 $O(ns+s^2)$ 的神经元通过 $O(s^2)$ 步生成来模拟，且这两个界均与电路深度无关，并在自然假设下是紧致的。对于阈值激活函数，这改进了 Joshi 等人（COLT 2025）的模拟结果，后者的界随电路深度呈指数增长。因此，自回归阈值神经元可以模拟多项式时间的图灵机……
tldr: 该论文证明一个使用阈值或ReLU等激活函数的单个自回归神经元，即可通过其生成的思维链模拟任意前馈电路乃至多项式时间图灵机，所需维度为O(ns+s²)、生成步数为O(s²)，且两个界均与电路深度无关并在此前指数级结果的基础上有显著改进。
en_tdlr: A single autoregressive neuron with threshold or ReLU activation can simulate any feedforward circuit—and hence polynomial-time Turing machines—through its generated chain-of-thought, using dimension O(ns+s²) and O(s²) generation steps, with both bounds independent of circuit depth and improving prior exponential-depth results.
